title: Vehicle / Unit Master
description: The record for one specific truck, whether it's a customer's unit coming in for service or a unit sitting on our lot.
x-sap-analogue: Equipment master (EQUI), serialized — VIN plays the role of the SAP equipment number
x-api-note: CDK Drive Service Vehicles API is documented (create/update/query) but does not include stock number in its schema; the inventory-side vehicle record is a separate, less publicly documented object.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

identification_vin.description: The 17-character factory VIN — the one truly universal key across every system
identification_vin.x-source-title: CDK Drive Service Vehicles — Microsoft Learn connector doc

vehicleid.description: CDK's own internal ID for this vehicle record, layered on top of VIN
vehicleid.x-source-title: CDK Drive Service Vehicles — Microsoft Learn connector doc

stock_number.description: Dealer-assigned inventory number set at intake, configurable per location/inventory type, and can change independently of VIN (e.g. after a used-to-wholesale reclass)
stock_number.x-source-title: Lithia connectCDK — Vehicle Inventory Setups, Stock Number Definition
